title: Tiger Brokers Clinches Best Retail Broker in Singapore at SIAS Investors' Choice Awards 2026

Ian Leong, CEO, Tiger Brokers Singapore received the Best Retail Broker Award on behalf of the company at the awards ceremony held on 21 October at Orchard Hotel Singapore.**media[1271329]**
